messages.author: 5a363da2ae84b3c2
messages.subject: Installing rstan from local binary
parts:
Hello,

Previously, I have successfully added rstan to an Internet-connected desktop using the ordinary set of commands. But since the computer I actually need rstan on does not have an Internet connection, I'm using a locally-stored binary taken from here. I think the locally-stored component of the process is giving the installer fits.

Things I've tried: I've installed the prerequisite libraries, successfully run the helloworld example to check C++ compilation and the PATH for Rtools is set correctly.

The command install.packages("D:/folder/stan-src-1.3.0.tgz", repos=NULL, type="source") kicks back the following error:
ERROR: cannot extract package from 'D:/folder/stan-src-1.3.0.tgz"
Warning messages:
1. running command '"C:/R/R-3.0.1/bin/x64/R" CMD INSTALL -l "D:\R_LIB" "D:/folder/stan-src-1.3.0.tgz"' had status 1
2. In install.packages"D:/folder/stan-src-1.3.0.tgz", repos=NULL,;
installation of package 'D:/folder/stan-src-1.3.0.tgz' had non-zero exit status

Thank you for your time.
dje
